title: Record
intro: Photos and videos you take here are fingerprinted and signed on your phone, as a record for you and your lawyer.

capture.cameraPermissionBody: To record evidence, Saakshi needs your camera. Photos and videos stay on your phone.
capture.micPermissionBody: Videos record sound too, so Saakshi needs your microphone.

locker.heading: Your records
locker.missing: This record is no longer on your phone.
locker.checkOkBody: Every file still matches its signed record, and the records are in an unbroken chain.
locker.checkProblemBody_one: {{count}} problem was found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.checkProblemBody_other: {{count}} problems were found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.chainHeadHelp: The SHA-256 of the last signed record. It covers every file above.

witness.help: Sends this record's fingerprint, time and place by SMS to people you choose, so that others hold it from today.
witness.title: Saakshi evidence record

certificate.title: Certificate, Part A
certificate.intro: This fills in Part A of the certificate that section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 asks for when electronic records are produced in court, with the hash report attached. The phone's make, model and the SHA-256 of each file are filled in for you.
certificate.partB: The certificate also needs Part B, filled in and signed by an expert. This app cannot provide Part B.
certificate.name: Your full name
certificate.relativeName: Name of your parent or spouse
certificate.imeiHint: Dial *#06# on this phone to see it. If it shows two, enter both, separated by a comma.
certificate.ownership: This phone is, by you (tick all that apply):
certificate.serialHint: Usually in Settings, under About phone.
certificate.signByHand: Print the certificate, then sign it and write the date, time and place by hand.
certificate.required: Fill in your name, your parent's or spouse's name, address and IMEI, and tick at least one box.
certificate.madeBody: It is saved with this record and goes into the bundle when you export it.
